title: LTI integration
subtitle: Connect GenOVA to your learning platform: teachers select their OVAs within a course, and grades are sent back to the LMS.
formHelp: Copy these details from the tool configuration in your LMS.
emptyDescription: Register your LMS so teachers can add GenOVA OVAs to their courses.
deleteDescription: GenOVA activities in this LMS will stop opening, and grades will no longer be sent. Enter the platform name to confirm.
toolDescription: Paste these details when adding GenOVA as an external LTI 1.3 tool in Moodle, Canvas, or Blackboard.
toolUrlHint: These URLs come from the address the backend receives requests on: in development that is the local server (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000), not this page's address, and an LMS running on another machine will not reach it. In production, set LTI_TOOL_URL in the backend to its public address.
launchUrlHint: Redirection URI, Tool URL, and Deep Linking
copyError: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.

errors.tool: Could not load GenOVA details for the LMS.

name.label: Name
name.help: A name to identify it here, such as “Moodle UPAO”.

deployment_ids.label: Deployment IDs
deployment_ids.help: In Moodle: “Deployment ID”. Enter one per line if there are several.

validation.name: Enter a name, such as “Moodle UPAO”.
validation.clientId: Copy the Client ID shown in your LMS.
validation.deployments: Enter at least one Deployment ID.
